// diagnostic

E3210

Couldn't fetch C library `{lib}` from nixpkgs.

What

Couldn't fetch C library `{lib}` from nixpkgs.

Why

`{lib}: c@system` asked Jet to provision `nixpkgs#{attr}`, but `nix build` failed: `{reason}`.

Fix

check the attr exists (`nix build nixpkgs#{attr}`), or point at a local build with `{lib}: c@"<path>"`, or install it and use `system`.
